result.title: FOCUS: Closed-Loop Attention Feedback for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding
result.summary: Processing every video frame through Vision-Language Models (VLMs) adds significant inference cost and limits their ability to comprehend real-time video. Existing approaches either sub-sample frames uniformly, ignoring content and missing important events, or prune visual tokens inside the VLM to cut per-call cost while still invoking the model on every sampled frame. We introduce FOCUS, a training-free three-layer framework that reduces the number of invocations and steers each one towards what matters. Temporal gating measures inter-frame dissimilarity in the patch-embedding space of a smaller VLM from the same family, triggering burst captures only when the scene changes in a semantically meaningful way. Patch-level dissimilarity is then accumulated across the burst and fused with a top-down attention prior into a spatial focus map that encodes where motion and semantic relevance coincide. That map calibrates the VLM's value cache during generation, progressively amplifying vision tokens in task-relevant regions and attenuating off-target ones, without removing any token from the context. The loop closes after each response: text-to-vision cross-attention is extracted from the decoder and fed back as the prior for the next burst, letting the system converge on semantically important regions over successive observations. We evaluate FOCUS on the 500-video EgoSchema subset in streaming mode, with a single Qwen3-VL-8B backbone shared by every method. It reaches 74.8% accuracy using 25.4 VLM calls per clip, against 74.6% with 55 calls for uniform sampling and 74.2% with 55 calls for BOLT. On egocentric video captioning across four domains, it matches the best baseline's quality while issuing 57% fewer VLM invocations than uniform sampling.

AI.brief_summary: FOCUS 提出免训练的三层框架：用小 VLM 的 patch 嵌入差异做时间门控决定何时采集，将 burst 内 patch 差异与自上而下注意力先验融合为空间关注图，并据此校正生成时的 value cache，再把解码器的文本-视觉跨注意力回传为下一轮先验，以减少 VLM 调用并聚焦任务相关区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时看、看哪里」的门控与闭环注意力反馈直接关联 LVR 的视觉证据筛选及 LOOK 侧收益成本；不删除 token 而靠 value cache 调制视觉状态，可供核查注意力与缓存结构对证据保留和 latent 相似度的影响。
